  • Method Details

    • authority

      public LoopbackBoundary.Builder authority(String value)
      The authority every request's Host must equal, and from which the accepted Origin is derived.

      Required. Must be the exact host-and-port spelling the application links to, e.g. "127.0.0.1:8790" — the boundary accepts one spelling, not a set (see the class javadoc's canonical-origin section).

      Parameters:
      value - The expected authority. Must not be null, blank, or carry a scheme or path.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If value is null, blank, or is not a bare host-and-port.

    • authority

      public LoopbackBoundary.Builder authority(String host, int port)
      Convenience form of authority(String) taking the host and port separately.
      Parameters:
      host - The bind host, e.g. "127.0.0.1". Must not be null or blank.
      port - The bind port. Must be positive.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If host is null/blank or port is not positive.

    • csrfHeader

      public LoopbackBoundary.Builder csrfHeader(String value)
      The header a state-changing request must carry the CSRF token in.
      Parameters:
      value - The header name. Must not be null or blank. Defaults to LoopbackBoundary.DEFAULT_CSRF_HEADER.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If value is null or blank.

    • token

      public LoopbackBoundary.Builder token(SynchronizerToken value)
      The token a state-changing request must present.

      Required. Normally one generated token per process, also embedded into every page the application serves.

      Parameters:
      value - The token. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      This object.
